chunks: From him, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Abī Ayyūb, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, who said:
I said to Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام: A man doubts his wudu (ablution) after he has finished the salat (prayer)? He said: “He proceeds on the basis of his salat and does not repeat.”

Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: If he is certain that he had invalidated his state, and is certain that he had purified himself, but does not know which of the two preceded the other, then wudu (ablution) is obligatory upon him so that doubt may be removed from him and he may enter his salat (prayer) upon certainty of taharah (ritual purity). This is indicated by the fact that a person is bound not to enter into salat except in a state of taharah, so he ought to be certain of having attained taharah for himself in order for it to be permissible for him to enter salat with it. Whoever does not know that his taharah preceded the hadath is not upon certainty regarding his taharah, and restarting it is obligatory upon him, as we have explained.

He, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: Whoever is upon certainty of taharah (ritual purity) and doubts its invalidation, then let him act upon his certainty and not pay attention to the doubt, and no purification is required of him unless he becomes certain of hadath. This indicates that.

key_terms.يَقِينٍ: certainty, the legal basis to be acted upon over doubt
key_terms.ٱلشَّكُّ: doubt or uncertainty regarding one's state of purification
key_terms.ٱلصَّلَاةِ: salat (prayer), the ritual prayer whose validity depends on purification
key_terms.ٱلطَّهَارَةِ: taharah (ritual purity), the state required before entering prayer
key_terms.ٱلْحَدَثَ: ritual invalidation that nullifies prior purification
key_terms.ٱلْوُضُوءِ: wudu (ablution), the ritual purification required for salat

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if someone doubts their wudu after prayer or is unsure whether purification came before or after hadath?
ai.summary: This passage addresses rulings of wudu (ablution) in relation to doubt before and after salat (prayer). It distinguishes between mere doubt after completing prayer, which does not require repetition, and a case where one is certain of both hadath and purification but uncertain which came later, in which case wudu must be renewed to establish certainty of taharah.
